title: Friday Night Magic 2009: card flavor text

entities.name: Myr Enforcer
entities.description: A myr that monitors other myr.

entities.name: Merrow Reejerey
entities.description: A merrow leader who guides the school.

entities.name: Lightning Greaves
entities.description: Greaves forged from steel made of ore on cliffs struck by lightning.

entities.name: Watchwolf
entities.description: A Ravnican wolf that watches the flock.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The city plane where wolves watch the flock.

entities.name: Jeska
entities.description: A warrior adept who says even the threat of power has power.

entities.name: Orochi
entities.description: Snake-folk of Kamigawa whose slain warriors are buried with saplings.

events.summary: Lightning strikes cliffs, turning ore to iron and steel and forging the Lightning Greaves.
events.quote: After lightning struck the cliffs, the ore became iron, the iron became steel, and the steel became greaves.

events.summary: Jeska says even the threat of power has power.
events.quote: Even the threat of power has power.

events.summary: Slain orochi warriors are buried with a sapling to join the forest.
events.quote: Slain orochi warriors were buried with a tree sapling so they would become a part of the forest after death.
